title: Velvety Sweet Chinese Chicken Noodles
description: A nutty and light Chinese dish featuring caramel sauce and pickle, made in a kadhai, this recipe is low in carbs and perfect for a quick dinner
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a kadhai over medium-high heat
Add the chicken to the kadhai and cook until browned, about 5 minutes
Remove the chicken from the kadhai and set aside
Add the shirataki noodles to the kadhai and cook for 2 minutes, stirring frequently
Add the caramel sauce, rice vinegar, and pickled ginger to the kadhai and stir to combine
Return the chicken to the kadhai and stir to coat with the sauce
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is bubbly
Stir in the green onions and sesame seeds
Serve the chicken and noodles hot, garnished with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired
